operator_level_dedup: The Altona Kilo-Shop and any additional DRK Hamburg Kilo-Shop observations governed by the same responsible Hamburg DRK identity are one supplier for census counting. Physical branches are not counted separately.
reason: Independent PASS2 confirms a current Hamburg professional second-hand clothing retail operation. The official DRK Hamburg Kilo-Shop page identifies the Altona shop, current opening hours and sale of carefully selected used clothing by weight and as individual fashion pieces. The same current first-party website identifies DRK Landesverband Hamburg e.V. as provider, with Behrmannplatz 3, register VR 4474 and published tax ID. No remote item-level catalogue, direct remote purchase path or ordinary delivery to Spain is established for this operator, so it is VERIFIED_HOLD rather than operationally eligible.

evidence.finding: Current DRK page lists DRK Kilo-Shop Altona at Neue Große Bergstraße 4-6, current opening hours, and explicitly describes sale of selected used clothing by weight and individual fashion pieces.
Current imprint identifies DRK Landesverband Hamburg e.V., Behrmannplatz 3, Vorstand, Vereinsregister VR 4474 and published tax ID.
Hamburg directory corroborates current DRK Kilo-Shop Altona as a second-hand clothing shop.

dedup_audit.current_repo_exact_search_result: Exact repository search for drk-hamburg.de and DRK Kilo-Shop Altona returned no prior canonical promotion before CP118B.
dedup_audit.historical_operator_note: Older DRK publications associated Kilo-Shops with a DRK Hamburg service subsidiary. The current 2026 first-party Kilo-Shop page is published under and legally attributed by the site imprint to DRK Landesverband Hamburg e.V.; this record uses the current responsible first-party identity and remains eligible for later identity refinement without increasing the supplier count.
